name: Sandeep Vaid
summary: Senior full-stack engineer with 4+ years shipping products end-to-end in Node.js/TypeScript and PostgreSQL, from React/React-Native frontends to cloud-native backends and third-party integrations (OAuth, webhooks, REST). Have owned technical architecture, scoping, estimation, and delivery as the senior-most engineer on the team, and built production AI agent systems — RAG, tool calling, and agent orchestration with MCP-style tool interfaces. Comfortable owning tradeoffs and running technical conversations with product and non-technical stakeholders.

bullets: Owned technical architecture and end-to-end delivery for a government MIS platform serving 6+ Indian state education boards — scoped work directly with Product and state program managers, set timelines and estimates that held, and drove design → CI/CD → production across Engineering, Product, and QA.

Architected a fault-tolerant ETL pipeline ingesting 100M+ records daily across 6+ states — integrated third-party NIC UDISE+ REST APIs with parallel batch extraction and PostgreSQL transactional staging with rollback, achieving 99.9% data consistency across distributed sync.

Built the reliability layer — exponential backoff retry logic, health-check endpoints, graceful failure handling, AWS CloudWatch monitoring, and Slack webhook alerting — so pipelines degrade gracefully and page on failure.

Designed a column-level differential reconciliation engine over 4–5 crore rows × 80–90 columns — diagnosed Materialized View upsert limits at 7 crore scale and migrated to indexed PostgreSQL tables with a pre-aggregated summary layer, cutting processing from hours to minutes.

Shipped a centralized observability dashboard across 6+ pipelines — replaced manual per-pipeline error-file sharing, eliminating 30–60 min per-incident debug handoff across 3 teams and translating incidents into plain-language status for non-technical stakeholders.
Migrated RBAC and Field Master configuration from DynamoDB to PostgreSQL — redesigned the schema and wrote migration verification scripts.
Delivered Guide products end-to-end across backend, frontend, and mobile — owning design through deployment and integration.
Integrated AWS Cognito OAuth authentication and built custom Lambda auth logic for secure user flows.
Built a customizable React theme-editor using hooks, Redux, and Saga, optimizing async operations for itinerary rendering.
Engineered advanced search with intelligent filtering (date, type, language, location, booking status), cutting search time by 2.35s.
Enhanced the react-native guide app — refined UX and published to the Play Store.
Architected a reusable service layer for configuration, dashboard, and task & dependency management — cutting manual operational workload by 80%.
Built an Administration Console with role-based access control (RBAC) for configuration management and real-time system monitoring.
Built an image-to-text OCR pipeline generating AI-powered product recommendations from extracted attributes.
Optimized the event server with JSON-schema validation, lifting throughput to 50,000 requests/second.
Developed a Shopify script for real-time behavioral data collection via Google Tag Manager integrations.

skills: Node.js, TypeScript, Express (NestJS-style layering), Django, Spring Boot; REST, OAuth, Webhooks
RAG (chunking, embeddings, pgvector semantic search), tool calling, LangGraph agent orchestration, prompt design, MCP-style tool interfaces, LLM APIs
React.js, Next.js, Angular, Redux, Redux-Saga, React Native, HTML5, CSS3
PostgreSQL (+ pgvector), MongoDB, DynamoDB, Snowflake, Redshift
AWS (Lambda, S3, CloudWatch, Cognito, EC2, Elastic Beanstalk), Vercel, CI/CD, Serverless, Cron Scheduling

projects.title: Learning Agentic AI — RAG, Tool-Calling & Agent Orchestration — github.com/sandeepvaid/learning-agentic-ai
points: Built end-to-end RAG pipelines (qna-rag, qna-rag-langgraph): document chunking, embedding generation, vector similarity retrieval, and context-grounded answer synthesis — orchestrated as multi-step agent flows in LangGraph (state, conditional routing, tool nodes).
Implemented pgvector semantic search on PostgreSQL — embedding storage and nearest-neighbour similarity queries — applying production PostgreSQL experience to vector workloads.

Built tool-calling agents (sql-agent, calculator-agent) where the LLM plans and invokes typed tools — the same primitive underlying MCP — with iterative prompt design for reliable tool selection, query rewriting, and structured output.
